name: Dread Weight
source:
Trapped in a crumbling mansion, it’s up to you to outsmart and outlive an ancient witch hunting you down. Scavenge items to set traps, solve puzzles and discover secret paths to avoid your demise. Don’t be scared: encounters with ghosts are rewarded in this horror visual novel. 

-Merging real world history with European folklore, Dread Weight is a deceptively cute horror title.

-A sequel to Cooking Companions that you can go into completely new: returning players get additional Chompettes, sidequests and story from the MC's perspective!

-Players can use the new inventory system to unlock new areas and solve puzzles throughout the mansion. Be careful! Vengeful spirits do not rest quietly: be quick on your feet and you’ll prevent being attacked by them.

-Death is not the end: there are no “Game Over” screens in Dread Weight, allowing you to keep going through the story uninterrupted.

-NO gratuitous violence or gore

-No swearing!

[from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
被困在摇摇欲坠的宅邸中，你必须智取追杀自己的古老女巫，并比她活得更久。搜集物品、布置陷阱、破解谜题，发现秘密通道，逃过死亡。别害怕，在这部恐怖视觉小说中，遭遇幽灵反而会获得奖励。

《Dread Weight》融合真实历史与欧洲民俗，是一款有着可爱表象的恐怖作品。

本作是《Cooking Companions》的续作，完全没有前作经验也能游玩。老玩家则能体验新增的Chompettes、支线任务，以及主人公视角的故事！

玩家可以运用全新的物品栏系统，解锁新区域，破解宅邸中的谜题。小心！复仇的幽灵不会安静长眠。动作够快，就能避免遭到攻击。

死亡并非终点：《Dread Weight》没有“游戏结束”画面，让你得以继续故事，不被打断。

没有刻意堆砌的暴力或血腥。

没有脏话！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/]Steam[/url]]
